Hero_Desc_Rohne:
The best elven spy who looks naive. Sometimes it makes you wonder if she really is the best.
No matter how you look at it, she just looks like the worst spy...
With her decent nature, she is able to fit in anywhere.
Album_Like_Rohne: 'Elf-riends', the No. 1 sitcom of all time on Elven TV, until Season 8. The charm of Medieval armor.
Album_Hate_Rohne: 'Elf-riends', the No. 1 sitcom of all time on Elven TV, from Season 8 to the end. The functionality of medieval armor.
Album_Rohne1: Rohne is a secret agent for the elven city. Practically isolated in Elias Forest, the elves have a very strong sense of identity, a personality trait that Rohne also embodies.
Album_Rohne2: Elven secret agents have a long-written history. When the elves settled in Elias Forest, they wore their traditional clothes and armor to seem approachable to the denizens of the forest, with a diplomatic delegation being dispatched at the heart of it all.
Album_Rohne3: Although Rohne finds the armor uncomfortable, she seems to have a love-hate relationship with it; she's been wearing it for so long it's become her lifestyle. She's even developed a bit of an obsession with cultural artifacts from the past, enjoying the collection of knight and swordsman figurines.
Album_Rohne4: Rohne is too naive for someone in her profession. Perhaps it's because she has only ever received training as a secret agent, she lacks knowledge in other areas.
Album_Rohne5: Since Rohne is at the very bottom, she seems to have a hard time with the other elves. Interestingly, she gets along well with Festa, the street musician. Of course, she doesn't seem to agree with Festa's strange ideas in her preaching.
Album_Rohne6: I made a suggestion to Rohne: Why not make various friends in Elias Forest, not just in the city? Initially, she was wagging her finger, looking uncomfortable, but when I introduced her to the others, she seemed to secretly enjoy it. She later expressed her gratitude for finding friends with whom she could meet up with comfortably and who don't mind her rank.
Album_Rohne7: I asked Rohne if she ever got in trouble for sneaking into the Sprite Kingdom. She proudly declared that hanging out with me proves she was a great spy. However, she added that I should keep this a secret from Amelia.
LoveHero_Rohne:
Is it the start of
an intelligence operation?
Operation name: Arch Bishop!
LoveHeroCancel_Rohne:
If you're a spy,
better get used to
the ruthless betrayal from your superiors...
*Sobs*
Food_ChefNote_Rohne_Hate1:
Rohne, who had thought this was the cutlet of her dreams, lost her temper and smacked Canna, who was passing by.
I had to watch The Rohne Apology Show for a week.
Food_ChefNote_Rohne_Hate2: For a very long time, I watched poor Rohne despair over how cruel the taste of reality was.
Food_ChefNote_Rohne_Like1:
For Rohne, chocolate ice cream is a joyful escape. 
Since she didn't want to be interrupted during her ice cream time, she kicked me and all the other guests out of the building.
Food_ChefNote_Rohne_Like10: Her hands trembled as she wondered whether someone like her was allowed to eat food this precious. She tried to lick the crumbs from the floor, and I barely managed to stop her.
Food_ChefNote_Rohne_Like2: After trying this, Rohne sang its praises, saying she found a level of grandeur she never expected to find in her lifetime.
Food_ChefNote_Rohne_Like3: Rohne was happy, saying it was better than the Star Candy regularly given to Monatium spies.
Food_ChefNote_Rohne_Like4: She seems to feel some sort of kinship, saying the identity of the hidden contents is like her own as a spy.
Food_ChefNote_Rohne_Like5: She was so hungry that she got powder all around her mouth while eating. It was quite amusing, so I teased her a little.
Food_ChefNote_Rohne_Like6: Rohne claimed she would never eat it but, after trying a bite, she ate it well. I heard from Santa that this actually came from a tree.
Food_ChefNote_Rohne_Like7: Rohne muttered that you could only eat this food after sticking on some googly eyes... It made me a little sad.
Food_ChefNote_Rohne_Like8: Rohne mentioned she knows how to enjoy Almond Pralines properly. She ordered some hot coffee to mix with it.
Food_ChefNote_Rohne_Like9: Rohne inspected the candy as if it were fascinating, remarking that eating one by one would keep her from getting bored during her spy activities.

LoveLetter_Rohne: It's me, Rohne, the kind, capable spy who never wastes a crumb!I'm so glad I can de-stress from work by talking about all kinds of things with you. I hope you feel the same even though I worry I might be blurting out classified secrets all the time! All I want is for you to have a great time, Master!Oh, and one more thing—my frequent trips to the Banquet Hall? Let's keep that a secret from Amelia, okay?
LoveCall_Rohne:
Hello, Master! It is Rohne, your friendly neighborhood spy. Hehe.
It feels like only yesterday that I first saw you and nearly fainted because I was so scared and nervous...
Yet before I knew it, we had become close enough for me to call you this casually.

I am so happy that we can be close and have fun together.
Of course, I felt a little miserable when you teased me with things like Air Cutlets... B-But now, it is f-f-fine! Everything you make in the banquet hall is d-delicious to me!
Um... Yes, I suppose the Air Cutlet is still not fine...

So next time, let us go eat a truly, truly delicious pork cutlet together!
I am working hard to save my salary so that I can treat you.
At this rate, I should be able to afford it very soon. Perhaps in about thirteen years?
Please wait just a little longer, Master! I will hang up now!

Affinity_Rohne_EP17_006: That is no way to make friends.

Affinity_Rohne_EP19_002: There is Levi, at the bottom of the Witch Kingdom's ranks.
Affinity_Rohne_EP19_003: ...Perhaps I have it a little better than her. I write reports, but at least I do not have to endure pressure over a thesis.
Affinity_Rohne_EP19_004: How about Jade? She is near the bottom among the Dragons.
Affinity_Rohne_EP19_005: She seems to have chosen the path of an outsider for herself... Still, she offered me some kind words she had read in a book.
Affinity_Rohne_EP19_006: Try getting along with Kommy, the youngest Beastfolk.
Affinity_Rohne_EP19_007: If they catch me befriending Beastfolk, I will receive penalty points! I suppose we will have to meet in secret, as private friends.
Affinity_Rohne_EP20_001: Sometimes I miss libraries on Earth. They had so many interesting books.
Affinity_Rohne_EP20_002: You read books on Earth too?

Affinity_Rohne_EP20_004: Does Monatium not have a library?
Affinity_Rohne_EP20_005: It does, but... I think books from Earth were more interesting than Elf books. Content made by other people is always tastier.
Affinity_Rohne_EP20_007: A story about tearing apart and eating a house made of sweets. I think that book helped me adapt easily to the Sprites' 'bread expeditions' too.
